create_process_definition: create a new process definition using mrp.process with name, runtime, config, and dependencies
register_process_with_env: register a process with environment variables using mrp.process and validate env is dict[str, str]
define_process_with_deps: define a process with dependencies on other processes using the deps parameter in mrp.process
serialize_procdef_asdict: serialize a ProcDef instance to a dictionary using the asdict method for inspection or storage
review_procdef_dataclass: review the ProcDef dataclass fields including name, root, rule_file, runtime, cfg, deps, and env
